title: longgame public data series
description: Initial public snapshot of a set of independently maintained public-data series. Each series records one quantity that cannot be reconstructed after the fact, with the source, collection date, and method stated on its page. Series include California SB 253/261 docket monitoring, SEC Form D private-placement counts, EIA-860M generator and queue aggregates, agent identity key directories, EU trusted list pointers, and AI Act registry availability checks. Some series are pending source availability and are labelled as such.
